cards.text: David, king of Israel, calls ALL the leaders of Israel to Jerusalem: tribe leaders, army commanders, the officials over the king's property and cattle, court officials, and every mighty man of valor. That's not a meeting, friend. That's the WHOLE contact list getting the same text: "Come now."
Then King David rises to his feet and says, “Listen to me, my brothers and my people.” When the king STANDS UP in front of that crowd, you put your phone DOWN.

cards.question: David tells the crowd something has been in his heart. What did he want to build?

answers.text: A house for the ark of the covenant
A palace of cedar for himself
A wall around all of Jerusalem

cards.question: True or false: David says he had already made preparations to build the house for the ark.

cards.text: So the dream is in his heart and the prep work has started. Then God tells David he is NOT the one to build a house for His Name.

cards.question: God tells David he won't be the one to build the house. What reason does God give?

answers.text: He is a man of war who shed blood
He is too old to see it finished
He did not ask the priests first

cards.text: If that were me, I'd go lie face down in the chocolate chips for a WEEK. But David points the crowd to what God DID do: the LORD chose him out of all his father's house to be king over Israel forever.

cards.question: David walks the crowd through how God chose him to be king, step by step. Which tribe did God choose as leader?

cards.text: Next David tells the crowd the LORD has given him many sons, and out of all of them, the LORD chose ONE for the throne. A whole tray of cookies, friend, and only ONE gets the box with the bow on it.

cards.question: Out of all David's many sons, the LORD has chosen ___ to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

cards.text: Then David shares what God told him: Solomon is the one who will build His house and His courts. The dad dreams it, the son builds it, and David is telling the WHOLE room.

cards.question: God also says He has chosen Solomon as His ___, and He will be Solomon's ___.
God promises to establish Solomon's kingdom forever, on one condition. What is it?

answers.text: He resolutely carries out God's commandments
He finishes building the house quickly
He defeats every enemy around Israel

cards.text: Now David tells the whole crowd, in the sight of all Israel and in the hearing of God, to keep and seek out all the commandments of the LORD. In the hearing of God, friend, NOBODY in that crowd gets to be on mute.

cards.question: David tells the leaders to keep and seek out God's commandments. What does he say will come of it?

answers.text: They possess the good land and pass it down
They never have to face another war
Their storehouses stay full every single year

cards.text: Then David looks right at his son. He tells Solomon to know the God of his father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind.

cards.question: David tells Solomon to serve God wholeheartedly, not halfway. Why does David say that matters?

answers.text: The prophets judge all his work

cards.question: True or false: David tells Solomon that if he seeks the LORD, the LORD will be found by him.
True or false: David tells Solomon that even if he forsakes the LORD, the LORD will never reject him.

cards.text: Then David reminds Solomon that the LORD chose him to build a house for the sanctuary and says, “Be strong and do it.”

Then David gives Solomon the plans: the portico, the rooms and treasuries, the divisions of the priests and Levites, and the weight of the gold and silver for the lampstands, tables, bowls and forks, right up to the gold cherubim spreading their wings over the ark. Friend, I measure chocolate chips by the mustache-full, and this plan weighs out the gold for every single BOWL. Then David tells Solomon where all these details came from.

cards.question: David tells Solomon where all the details of this plan came from. What does he say?

answers.text: The LORD made them clear to him in writing
His counselors drew them up over many years
He copied them from the old tabernacle plans

cards.text: Then David tells Solomon, “Be strong and courageous, and do it.” That's the second time he's said be strong, and when a step shows up on the recipe card TWICE, friend, you do NOT skip it.

cards.question: True or false: David tells Solomon not to be afraid or discouraged, because the LORD God is with him.
David promises the LORD will neither fail Solomon nor forsake him before all the work for the service of the ___ of the LORD is finished.

cards.text: And Solomon won't be building this alone. David says the divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of the house of God.

cards.question: David says the priests and Levites are ready. Who else does he say will be at Solomon's disposal for the work?

answers.text: Every willing man of every skill
Only the strongest men of Judah
Workers paid from the royal treasury

cards.text: The officials and all the people are fully at Solomon's command. We'll pause David's big assembly right there, friend, but trust me, it's not over.
